reason_not_confirmatory: V1.2.4 outcomes on these historical OOS folds have already been observed. V1.3 may develop a method on the same frozen corpus but cannot constitute independent confirmation.

data_policy.feature_matrices: reuse frozen V1.2.3 strong-M0 and Sol matrices byte-for-byte
data_policy.baseline_predictions: reuse frozen V1.2.4 M0 probabilities byte-for-byte
data_policy.labels: same local frozen historical corpus semantics used in V1.2.4

arms.M0: frozen V1.2.4 strong deterministic baseline probabilities
arms.M1_STABLE: same strong deterministic baseline feature matrix plus only Sol columns selected by nested training-only stability selection

selection_rule.scope: independently inside each outer target/fold using outer-training rows only
selection_rule.candidate_pool: all family-specific Sol columns meeting outer-training 60% nonmissing coverage
selection_rule.stability_subfit: elastic-net logistic grid search using the same pipeline, C grid, l1_ratio grid and 4-split chronological tuning CV as the frozen fitter; calibration omitted because only coefficient support/sign is used
selection_rule.selection_requirement: nonzero Sol coefficient in at least 2 of 3 successful stability subfits AND identical sign in every nonzero occurrence
selection_rule.if_zero_selected: M1_STABLE uses the exact M0 feature matrix for that target/fold

final_fit_rule.m0_reason: carry forward the already-frozen identical strong-baseline predictions to avoid stochastic or execution drift

scoring.primary_set: same 3057-fixture V1.2.4 frozen primary retrospective transferability set
scoring.family_weighting: equal weight across fixed primary targets within family
scoring.bootstrap: paired ISO-week block bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 0
scoring.screen_thresholds: same numerical thresholds as V1.2.4, reported descriptively only because V1.3 is exploratory

interpretation.positive_result: evidence that training-only stable subset selection may improve representation; not independent confirmation
interpretation.negative_result: no evidence that this stability-selection representation rescues the frozen Sol hypothesis set
